# Project Design Context

Curated design context for the Chatbase-inspired marketing page.

## Project

- Name: dossier-scraper-ai
- Product type: Marketing site
- Stack: React, Vite
- Color mode: Light
- Density: Comfortable
- Sources: `src/styles.css`, `src/App.jsx`, `DESIGN (2).md`

## Design Intent

A light, editorial single-page experience that follows the supplied Chatbase references. The page keeps a centered, thinly bordered frame over a #FAFAFA field, uses Geist for UI copy and Proza Libre italic for one hero accent, and tells a three-part narrative: acquisition hero, customer-facing agents, and a sticky lifecycle workflow.

## Tokens

### Color

- Page: `#FAFAFA`
- Paper: `#FFFFFF`
- Ink: `#0A0A0A`
- Body text: `#3F3F46`
- Muted: `#71717A`
- Line: `#E4E4E7`
- Brand blue: `#2C41B3`
- Purple: `#8E51FF`
- Accent blue: `#3B82F6`
- Pink: `#F6339A`
- Green: `#22C55E`
- Amber: `#F59E0B`
- Red: `#EF4444`

### Typography

- Sans: Geist, with Inter/system sans fallback.
- Serif accent: Proza Libre, italic, hero second line only.
- Hero title: `clamp(46px, 4.2vw, 60px)`, weight 600, tight tracking.
- Body: 16px with a 1.5 line-height baseline.

### Layout

- Page frame: 1232px maximum, centered, 1px side borders.
- Header: 68px sticky with a light translucent background on desktop.
- Hero: 724px minimum height on desktop, split into copy and blue diamond panel.
- Workflow: one shared stack; cards stick at 96px with 10px visual offsets and 48vh spacing.
- Mobile: single column below 720px; full-bleed frame below 640px.

### Depth and Motion

- Radii: 8px base, 999px pills.
- Shadows: subtle 1–2px card shadows; larger floating surfaces use up to 70px blur.
- Easing: `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)` and `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`.
- Reduced motion is respected across scroll, reveal, typed chat, and workflow transitions.

## Components and Patterns

- Split hero with an interactive Procedures card and CSS diamond pattern.
- Ten-cell customer logo wall using inline SVG marks.
- Three agent cards with CSS cubes, grid backdrops, and decorative typed conversations.
- Quote band with serif accents and a large stat panel.
- Sticky four-card Build/Test/Deploy/Optimize workflow.
- Blue CTA panel and a compact multi-column footer.
- Full-height mobile menu overlay with body scroll lock and focus trap.
- Preferred primitives: semantic links, native buttons, `role="switch"` for procedure toggles.

## Constraints

### Must

- Use the light palette and the centered 1232px page frame.
- Keep Geist for body/UI and Proza Libre only for the hero accent.
- Preserve the three-part narrative and the sticky workflow interaction.
- Keep core visuals CSS/SVG-based with no external image dependency.
- Preserve keyboard focus, reduced-motion handling, and inert background content while the mobile menu is open.

### Avoid

- Dark-page styling or the previous dossier/chat landing layout.
- Legacy multi-page links or Vite integration with `index.legacy.html`.
- Additional product sections beyond the requested flow.
- Replacing the sticky workflow with a static gallery or carousel.

## Decisions

- 2026-10-20: Ship a light, single-scroll Chatbase-style marketing page with a bordered editorial frame.
- 2026-10-20: Use a blue diamond hero panel and interactive procedures preview rather than external imagery.
- 2026-10-20: Implement the lifecycle as direct sticky cards in one shared stack so each card covers the previous one.
- 2026-10-20: Make the mobile menu a full-height overlay with focus trapping, Escape handling, inert page content, and automatic desktop close.

## Evidence

- `src/styles.css` defines color, type, spacing, radius, shadow, and motion tokens.
- `src/App.jsx` implements the hero, agent chats, sticky lifecycle, mobile menu focus trap, and inert background.
- `DESIGN (2).md` provides the reference palette and section flow.
